author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수천 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 저수지, 물이 고인 논, 호수, 하구, 해안의 얕은 물
summary: 저수지, 물이 고인 논, 호수, 하구, 해안 등 물이 얕은 곳에서 지내는 겨울철새로, 목을 곧게 세운 채 헤엄친다. 국내에서는 동해안 석호, 낙동강 하구, 천수만, 금강 하구, 주남저수지, 한강, 전라남도 진도·해남 등지에서 겨울을 난다. 국외에서는 아이슬란드에서 시베리아에 걸친 툰드라, 지중해, 인도 북부, 일본에 분포한다.

points.en: large yellow bill base extending forward to a wedge-shaped point

similar.how: 부리의 노란 부분이 더 넓고 부리 앞쪽으로 길게 뻗어 끝이 삼각형을 이룬다.

art.subject: Whooper Swan (Cygnus cygnus), adult (sexes alike), as seen in Korea from November to March: entire plumage pure white, the head and upper neck sometimes stained rusty-buff from feeding in muddy water; bill black on the tip and along the lower edge, with a large lemon-yellow patch at the base that reaches back to the eye and extends forward past the nostril in a long wedge-shaped point; dark eye; black legs and feet.
art.pose: swimming with the neck held straight and upright
art.scene: shallow Korean wetland in winter: a flooded rice paddy beside a lake; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view swimming with the neck held straight and upright: pure white plumage, long wedge-shaped head, black-tipped bill with a large yellow base
adult, head detail in side view: yellow bill base extending forward beyond the nostril to a wedge-shaped point, black tip and lower edge, yellow reaching back to the eye
first-winter, side view swimming: plumage dull grey-brown, paler on the underparts, bill pale pinkish-white with a black tip and no yellow yet
art.build: Very large swan, about 150cm, much bigger than any goose; long, straight neck usually held stiffly upright when swimming, without an S-curve. Head long and wedge-shaped, the forehead sloping straight into the long bill. Bill about as long as the head, flat-topped, without a knob. Legs short and black, with large webbed feet. Tail short and pointed, held low on the water. In flight long-necked, with all-white wings.
avoid: Do not paint a small rounded yellow patch that stops short of the nostril; that is Tundra Swan (Cygnus columbianus).
Do not paint an orange bill with a black knob, or an S-curved neck with raised wings; that is Mute Swan (Cygnus olor).
Do not paint pink or grey legs; they are black.
